About

Data that
gets things done

I've spent over 7 years helping organizations make sense of their data and act on it with confidence. Analytics has always been at the center of the product, marketing, and customer experience work I've been part of.

Right now at Verizon, I lead analytics consulting across site optimization and MarTech. That means building out experimentation frameworks, keeping executive dashboards running and useful, and making sure A/B test results actually shape what gets built next.

Before Verizon, I worked with PwC on financial automation and got my start at ADP and in healthcare analytics. That mix of industries has given me a perspective most digital analysts don't have.

Outside of work, I'm passionate about playing sports (badminton, pickleball, cricket, and table tennis), cooking (Indian, Japanese, and Italian), photography, hiking, and exploring new adventures.

Things I've
built

Click any project to explore details, spanning analytics, data engineering, and software development.

Jun 2017 – Aug 2017 · ADP
Employee Performance Management System
▼
A single-page web application enabling employees to log in and track task progress and performance. Used MBO (Management by Objective) to analyze each employee's performance across measurables. Allowed CEOs to create MBO cycles, managers to create departmental MBOs and rate subordinates, and all users to submit peer reviews.
Jul 2017 · ADP
Twitter Data Analysis
▼
Focused data analysis of 10K+ tweets including data cleaning and redundancy elimination. Analyzed tweet trends over a 5-year span and performed predictive analysis using Monte Carlo simulation. Generated bar graphs, pie-charts, and histograms in Tableau.
Dec 2016 · New Jersey Institute of Technology
PSP (PL/SQL Server Pages) Web Front-End
▼
Built a relational database with a web front-end, demonstrating full-stack database integration. Enabled users to set up an Emergency Alert Service by entering their cell phone number and carrier details via a PL/SQL-powered interface.
Dec 2015 · New Jersey Institute of Technology
Text Mining
▼
Data mining on server-generated log files to identify the most accessed content on a website. Addressed challenges of analyzing huge data volumes in research-scale databases, using web log analysis techniques to surface actionable insights.
Apr 2015 · VNRVJIET
Conditional Shortest Path Routing in Delay Tolerant Networks
▼
Studied Delay Tolerant Networks (DTNs) where nodes know the probabilistic distribution of contacts. Introduced a new metric, conditional intermeeting time, and proposed the CSPR protocol to route messages over conditional shortest paths, outperforming conventional intermeeting time approaches.
Aug 2014 · VNRVJIET
Data Envision
▼
Analyzed a school database to track and visualize student performance. Generated pie-charts and bar graphs for effective data visualization, and built anticipation models to forecast future student performance.
